verdict.rationale: Sandbox simulation of the transaction lifecycle is a fair capability to ask of a card-issuing platform, but the pack never documents simulating authorizations, clearings, reversals, refunds, or declines in a test environment. The only testing-related item covers forcing verification-check failures, which is an adjacent onboarding/KYC test flow rather than transaction simulation. Relayed authorisation and transaction rules describe live auth decisioning, not a way to simulate transactions in sandbox.
